notes.title: Pet the dog
notes.content:
Pet the dog?!

With this bugfix/patch thing of today we are adding some small thing to the game. Now you can pet the dog in the game. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31782178/528f0372165bc8b615f6dff3c96d096b855b387b.gif

Bugfixes

 Missing a message saying the Rider was unlocked during the game ending

Additions:
 Rider now has a icon on the HP bar
 You now can pet the dog
 Added an small interval between the jumps when you fall from a plataform. This interval only works for ice.

notes.title: French localization and Vsync
notes.content:
French localization and v-sync

Hello! Today we are releasing the french localization! Thanks to our friend Lucas  Almeida who translated to french.  
Its been two days since a friend asked to be possible to toggle vsync in the game. Now its possible, just go on the screen menu and enable it. 

:smileybones:

Changelog:
Bugfixes

 Ghost option in menu
 Missing 'ç' letter
 Typos in the achievements

Additions

 Added french localization
 Added vsync option


Fan art

Also look at this awesome fan art made by a friend (elranno). He is the person who made lots of ilustrations to Rivals of Aether and Lovers of Aether. 
[code]
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31782178/748c8bbfd2cac057bf9e2ee6da57a089488c91ef.png
Here's his twitter @elranno
[/code]

notes.title: Spanish localization
notes.content:
Spanish localization

Firstly we have to thank our dear friend, Lucas Millan for helping localizing our game to spanish and reviewing portuguese and english texts in the game.

Bugfixes
And of course, some fixes.

	Was impossible to change the buttons from dpad to analog on joystick key selection
	Missing collision in the ceiling of the forest level
	Fixed some translations in portuguese and english
    "Select a mission" text was now added to the translation list
    The game was keeping a fixed random seed upon death

notes.title: Bugfixes and soundtrack
notes.content:
Bugfixes
Hello! First we have to thank evebody who purchased the game. Hope you guys enjoyed so far.

W received some feedback about bugs... And we fixed most of them without breaking anything (I hope?).


Bugs:


 	Getting stuck inside the conveyor belts causing a soft lock
 	Final boss failing to start an attack
 	Doing the combo while dashing in the forest level causes the player to display inside the ground
 	Archiviement of the single floppy drive not beeing triggered
 	Eletric berry always triggered
    Scaling window was not saving properly the settings	
 

Additions:


 	In the screen menu it's now possible to set a fixed color pallet


Bugfixes

About the game soundtrack, we want to release in more places. So far you can get it here  on bandcamp. 
There are some really smal things we must do here and there... But we are getting there :smileybones:


Thnaks! <3
